Why are UI components important? Components promote consistency, efficiency, and scalability. They let developers reuse code and maintain a cohesive look and feel across the entire application. Key characteristics of great components? Well-designed components are modular, customizable, and accessible. They have clear functionality and adapt easily to any design language. How do components improve UX? Familiar, consistent interactions make navigation intuitive. Recognizable patterns reduce cognitive load and help users accomplish tasks faster.

blurb: Gathers ratings on a 0-8 scale with an optional explanation.
description: A shadcn Dialog with a 9-option radio button scale (0-8) and textarea for explaining the rating, separated by a header border.
use_when: Collecting structured feedback on onboarding difficulty, feature usability, or user satisfaction with explanations.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where small radio buttons are difficult to select; consider a simpler star or thumbs-up scale…
a11y: Radio buttons use shadcn RadioGroup; fieldset has a legend describing the question; textarea has aria-label; full keyboard navigation.

name: comp-327
title: Invite Members Dialog
blurb: Invite team members via email or shareable magic link.
description: A shadcn Dialog with dynamically addable email input fields and a read-only magic link with copy-to-clipboard button.
use_when: Onboarding team members through email invitations or sharing referral links with your product.
avoid_when: When you have no referral or team invitation system — the component assumes both email and link-based invitation are…
a11y: Email fields are properly labeled; copy button has aria-label; tooltip uses TooltipProvider; keyboard navigation fully supported.

name: comp-326
title: Sign In Dialog
blurb: Modal for account login with email, password, and remember-me option.
description: A shadcn Dialog with email and password fields, a remember-me checkbox, forgot-password link, and Google login option.
use_when: Authenticating returning users with a lightweight, non-navigating sign-in flow embedded in the page.
avoid_when: When you need robust credential validation or multi-factor authentication — the form is intentionally minimal.
a11y: Form fields have unique IDs with associated labels; password is type=password; checkbox is properly labeled; full keyboard support.

name: comp-328
title: Card Details Dialog
blurb: Modal for updating credit card payment details.
description: A shadcn Dialog using react-payment-inputs for card number, expiry, and CVC fields; includes name, card type detection, and default payment method checkbox.
use_when: Collecting or updating payment card information in account settings or checkout flows.
avoid_when: On mobile with limited keyboard space — card inputs are best on desktop; handle sensitive data securely on the backend.
a11y: Card fields are labeled with IDs; card type icon is aria-hidden; all inputs keyboard-navigable via react-payment-inputs.

name: comp-330
title: Change Plan Dialog
blurb: Modal for selecting a new subscription plan with pricing and features.
description: A shadcn Dialog with radio-button plan selector (Essential, Standard, Enterprise) and a checklist of included features.
use_when: Allowing existing users to upgrade or downgrade their subscription plan with transparent pricing.
avoid_when: With many plans or complex feature differences — the dialog is optimized for simple 3-plan choices.
a11y: Plan radio buttons have aria-describedby for pricing; labels properly associated; checkmarks are aria-hidden; full keyboard navigation.

name: comp-329
title: Checkout Payment Dialog
blurb: Checkout dialog for subscription billing with plan selection and card payment.
description: A shadcn Dialog with radio-button plan selector (Monthly/Yearly), card details via react-payment-inputs, optional coupon input, and subscribe button.
use_when: Collecting subscription payments with plan choice and optional promotional codes.
avoid_when: For complex pricing tiers or per-seat calculations — this form handles simple binary plan choice.
a11y: Plan radio buttons are keyboard-navigable; card fields properly labeled; coupon input auto-focuses when shown; full keyboard support.

name: comp-331
title: Edit Profile Dialog
blurb: Modal for updating profile with name, bio, website, and image uploads.
description: A scrollable shadcn Dialog with background and avatar image uploads, name fields, website, bio with character counter.
use_when: Allowing users to update their profile information including photos, name, website, and biography.
avoid_when: For very large files or complex image cropping — this form handles basic file uploads and previews.
a11y: Form fields are labeled; bio has aria-describedby for character count; aria-live=polite for live updates; image buttons have aria-labels.

name: comp-332
title: Onboarding Stepper Dialog
blurb: Multi-step onboarding dialog with progress indicators and skip option.
description: A shadcn Dialog with 4 steps, each displaying an image, title, and description; progress dots show current position; next/okay buttons advance.
use_when: Guiding new users through product features or setup with informational steps.
avoid_when: For complex workflows requiring data collection between steps — this is a read-only tour.
a11y: Dialog has proper header and description; progress dots are visual-only; buttons labeled; keyboard navigation supported; skip and close both exit.

name: comp-333
title: Command Palette Search
blurb: Keyboard-accessible command palette with search and grouped actions.
description: A shadcn CommandDialog triggered by Cmd+K, with searchable commands grouped by Quick Start and Navigation, showing keyboard shortcuts.
use_when: Providing power-users with keyboard-driven access to app actions and navigation.
avoid_when: For touch-only interfaces — the Cmd+K shortcut is desktop-only.
a11y: CommandDialog provides full keyboard navigation; input auto-focused on open; icons are aria-hidden; shortcuts displayed visually.

name: comp-335
title: Accordion Plus Minus
blurb: Accordion with plus/minus icon cycling through open/closed states.
description: Origin UI accordion. Plus icon (+) becomes minus (-) on expand. Emphasizes the open/closed duality visually.
use_when: FAQs or documentation where ± icons are more intuitive than rotation.
avoid_when: Accessibility concern: ± icons less standard than chevron rotation.
a11y: Icon is aria-hidden. Button has aria-expanded.

name: comp-334
title: Accordion With Chevron
blurb: Accordion with chevron icon showing/hiding per item.
description: Origin UI accordion variant using Radix UI primitives. Chevron icon rotates 180° on expand, styled with hover effects.
use_when: FAQ pages with visual expand/collapse indicators and hover feedback.
avoid_when: When chevron rotation feels excessive — some users find it distracting.
a11y: Chevron is aria-hidden (purely decorative). Button has aria-expanded.

name: comp-340
title: Accordion Subheader Chevron
blurb: Accordion with subheader text and chevron icon.
description: Main header with a subheader line (smaller text) above content. Chevron rotates on expand.
use_when: Headers with description lines (e.g., 'What is X?' with 'General Category' subtext).
avoid_when: When header text alone is sufficient.
a11y: Subheader included in button text or aria-label for context.

name: comp-341
title: Accordion Subheader Plus Minus
blurb: Accordion with subheader and plus/minus icon.
description: Subheader text with ± icon toggling open/closed.
use_when: Headers with supporting descriptive text and ± toggle.
avoid_when: When plus/minus feels less intuitive than chevron.
a11y: Subheader in button context for screen readers.

name: comp-339
title: Accordion Icon Plus Minus
blurb: Accordion with colored plus/minus icon for expand/collapse.
description: Plus/minus icon with color change on state transition, adding emphasis.
use_when: Color-coded accordions, high-contrast requirements.
avoid_when: Monochromatic designs.
a11y: Icon is aria-hidden. Color change supplements aria-expanded.

name: comp-336
title: Accordion Left Chevron
blurb: Accordion with left-aligned chevron that rotates on expand.
description: Chevron positioned to the left of the header text, rotates 90° or 180° on expand.
use_when: When icon should appear before text (RTL-friendly or design preference).
avoid_when: When right-aligned icons are the standard in your design system.
a11y: Chevron is aria-hidden. Button has aria-expanded.

name: comp-338
title: Accordion Icon Chevron
blurb: Accordion with colored icon indicators for expanded state.
description: Chevron icon changes color (not just rotation) when section is open, providing dual visual feedback.
use_when: Emphasizing open/closed state beyond rotation, strong color themes.
avoid_when: Low-contrast designs or when color alone is the only state indicator.
a11y: Chevron is aria-hidden. Color change should not be the sole state indicator.

name: comp-342
title: Accordion Icon Subheader Chevron
blurb: Accordion with icon, header, and subheader on the left with chevron.
description: Leading icon (left side) with header and subheader text, chevron on right.
use_when: Icon + text headers with category indicators, subheader descriptions.
avoid_when: Simple text-only headers.
a11y: Icon included in button or marked aria-hidden with text alternatives.

name: comp-343
title: Accordion Icon Subheader Plus Minus
blurb: Accordion with icon, header, subheader, and plus/minus toggle.
description: Icon + header + subheader on left, ± icon on right.
use_when: Rich headers with icons and supporting text, ± toggle feedback.
avoid_when: Sparse content that doesn't benefit from icon + subheader layout.
a11y: Icon and text properly associated for context.

name: comp-337
title: Accordion Left Plus Minus
blurb: Accordion with left-aligned plus/minus icon.
description: Plus/minus icon on the left side of headers, swaps icons on expand/collapse.
use_when: Consistent icon positioning on the left when ± suits your design.
avoid_when: LTR designs expecting right-aligned icons.
a11y: Icon is aria-hidden. Button has aria-expanded.

name: comp-344
title: Card Accordion Chevron
blurb: Card-styled accordion with chevron icon.
description: Each accordion section rendered as a distinct card with border, shadow, and chevron toggle.
use_when: Card-based UI where each FAQ item is a prominent card with elevation.
avoid_when: Flat layouts.
a11y: Button with aria-expanded, card has semantic role.

name: comp-345
title: Card Accordion Plus Minus
blurb: Card accordion with plus/minus icon.
description: Card-styled sections with ± toggle.
use_when: Card-based FAQ with ± indicators.
avoid_when: Chevron-preference designs.
a11y: Button with aria-expanded.

name: comp-351
title: Table Accordion Left Plus Minus
blurb: Table accordion with left plus/minus icon.
description: Table row accordion with ± toggle on the left.
use_when: Expandable table rows with ± indicators.
avoid_when: Non-table layouts.
a11y: Table structure with aria-expanded.

name: comp-350
title: Table Accordion Left Chevron
blurb: Table-integrated accordion with left chevron.
description: Accordion items styled as table rows with left-aligned chevron toggle.
use_when: Expandable table rows, data tables with additional details.
avoid_when: Standalone accordion — use standard accordion.
a11y: Rows have proper aria-expanded, table structure preserved.

name: comp-346
title: Card Accordion Left Chevron
blurb: Card accordion with left-aligned chevron.
description: Card-styled with chevron on the left side.
use_when: Card layouts with left-aligned toggle icons.
avoid_when: Right-aligned toggle preference.
a11y: Button with aria-expanded.

name: comp-347
title: Card Accordion Left Plus Minus
blurb: Card accordion with left-aligned plus/minus icon.
description: Card-styled with ± on the left.
use_when: Card FAQ with left-aligned ± toggle.
avoid_when: Right-aligned toggle systems.
a11y: Button with aria-expanded.

name: comp-321
title: Newsletter Subscribe Dialog
blurb: Modal to collect email addresses for newsletter subscriptions.
description: A shadcn Dialog containing an email input with a mail icon, subscribe button, and privacy policy notice.
use_when: Converting website visitors into newsletter subscribers or email list signups.
avoid_when: When users have already opted in — repeated prompts damage trust.
a11y: Email input has aria-label; mail icon is aria-hidden; inherits keyboard navigation from shadcn Dialog.

name: comp-348
title: Chevron FAQ Accordion
blurb: FAQ accordion with chevron icons for expand/collapse.
description: Pre-built FAQ layout with chevron-based accordion sections.
use_when: Dedicated FAQ page with professional styling.
avoid_when: Embedded FAQs in other pages.

name: comp-353
title: Icon Multi-Level Accordion
blurb: Nested accordion with icons for multi-level navigation.
description: Multi-level accordion with icon indicators at each level.
use_when: Hierarchical navigation or categorized content with visual icon cues.
avoid_when: Flat structures.
a11y: Semantic nesting, proper aria attributes.

name: comp-352

avoid_when: Flat FAQ lists.
a11y: Proper nesting preserves semantic structure and keyboard navigation.

name: comp-354
title: Simple Tooltip

avoid_when: Complex tooltip content; use a more feature-rich component instead.

name: comp-349
title: Plus Minus Accordion
blurb: FAQ accordion with plus/minus icon toggles.
description: FAQ layout with ± icons for open/closed state.
use_when: FAQ pages preferring ± visual language.
avoid_when: When chevron is the standard.
a11y: Semantic accordion structure.

name: comp-356
title: Arrow Tooltip

a11y: Button is fully accessible; tooltip is shown via hover only, not keyboard-accessible.

name: comp-357

name: comp-355

blurb: A button with a dark-themed tooltip that appears immediately on hover.
description: Wraps a button in a TooltipProvider and Tooltip with a dark background that remains dark regardless of theme.

avoid_when: Adaptive theming where the tooltip should match the current theme.
a11y: Button is fully accessible; tooltip is shown via hover only, not keyboard-accessible.

name: comp-360
title: Directional Pan Tooltips

avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces; the tight grid is hard to tap.

name: comp-362

blurb: A tooltip showing chart-like data with colored bullet points and rows.

avoid_when: Complex visualizations; tooltips should stay simple and scannable.

name: comp-358
title: Icon Rich Tooltip
blurb: A tooltip with an icon and title/body text laid out horizontally.
description: Dark tooltip displaying an icon on the left and multiline text content (title and description) on the right.
use_when: Tooltips that need visual iconography alongside explanatory text.
avoid_when: Small screens or narrow containers where icon+text layout breaks.

name: comp-359
title: Image Tooltip

name: comp-361

blurb: A tooltip showing stats in a two-column label/value grid.

name: comp-363

name: comp-364

name: comp-365

avoid_when: Primary actions or when menu space is limited.

name: comp-368

avoid_when: Simple text-only menus or when icons are unnecessary.

name: comp-369

name: comp-370
title: Labeled Grouped Dropdown
blurb: Grouped dropdown menu with section labels.
description: A dropdown combining groups, separators, and DropdownMenuLabel to clearly label each section.
use_when: Groups need explicit labels for clarity.
avoid_when: Simple menus or when labels are obvious from context.

name: comp-371
title: Checkbox Dropdown Menu

name: comp-374

name: comp-373

avoid_when: Simple menus where shortcuts and nesting add clutter.
a11y: Shortcuts are visual hints; nested navigation is keyboard accessible.

name: comp-375

name: comp-378

avoid_when: When help is integrated into a dedicated help section.

name: comp-377

avoid_when: When a dedicated account settings page is preferred.

name: comp-380

avoid_when: When theme is automatically determined.

name: comp-382

name: comp-385

name: comp-389

name: comp-390

avoid_when: When you need icons or placeholder avatars.

name: comp-381

name: comp-391

avoid_when: Complex sorting, filtering, or pagination needs.
a11y: Uses <table>, <thead>, <tbody> semantics. Ensure <th> with scope attributes.

name: comp-467
title: Table With Avatars
blurb: Table with avatar images in rows for user/team display.
description: A table variant where one column displays circular avatar images, common for user/contributor lists.
use_when: Showing users, team members, or entities with profile pictures.
avoid_when: Non-user data or when avatars are irrelevant.
a11y: Avatars must have alt text. Ensure table structure is clear.

name: comp-468
title: Rounded Rows Table
blurb: Table with rounded corners on row containers.
description: A table styled with rounded borders on each row, giving a card-like appearance.
use_when: A softer, less grid-like table aesthetic is desired.
avoid_when: When a strict grid layout is important.
a11y: Rounded styling is visual only. Table semantics remain standard.

name: comp-469
title: Striped Rows Table
blurb: Table with alternating row background colors for readability.
description: A table with zebra-striped rows (alternating background colors) to improve readability.
use_when: Many rows need clearer visual separation.
avoid_when: Few rows or when striping is visually unwanted.
a11y: Striping is visual only. Semantic table structure required.

name: comp-470
title: Vertical Lines Table
blurb: Table with vertical dividers between columns.
description: A table with borders/lines separating each column vertically.
use_when: Column boundaries need explicit visual separation.
avoid_when: When column separation is clear via spacing alone.
a11y: Lines are visual; table structure drives meaning.

name: comp-473
title: Table With Checkboxes
blurb: Table with checkbox column for row selection.
description: A table with a checkbox column allowing bulk selection of rows.
use_when: Users need to select multiple rows for batch operations.
avoid_when: Single-select or display-only contexts.
a11y: Checkboxes are keyboard-navigable. Master checkbox selection logic required.

name: comp-471
title: Compact Header Table
blurb: Table with a compact header row and minimal padding.
description: A table with a tight header section (smaller text/padding) to reduce vertical space.
use_when: Displaying many rows with space constraints.
avoid_when: When readability or spacing is paramount.
a11y: Ensure header text remains readable despite compact styling.

name: comp-472
title: Selectable Rows Table
blurb: Table with clickable rows that highlight on selection.
description: A table where rows are clickable, with visual feedback on selection/hover.
use_when: Selecting rows to perform actions or view details.
avoid_when: Display-only tables without interaction.
a11y: Rows must be keyboard-accessible. Click handler and focus management required.

name: comp-475
title: Paginated Data Table
blurb: Table with pagination controls to browse large datasets.
description: A table with prev/next or page-number buttons below, allowing navigation through multiple pages.
use_when: Dataset is too large to display at once.
avoid_when: Small datasets or when virtualization/infinite scroll is preferred.
a11y: Pagination buttons are keyboard-accessible. Page state must be announced.

name: comp-474
title: Vertical Key Value Table
blurb: Table displayed in a key-value format, one per row, vertically stacked.
description: A table variant where each row shows a key (label) and its value, styled like a definition list.
use_when: Displaying sparse or hierarchical key-value data.
avoid_when: Dense multi-column data comparison.
a11y: Structure should use <dt> and <dd> or similar semantic pairing.

name: comp-477
title: Interactive Selectable Table
blurb: Table with multi-select checkboxes and column totals.
description: Data table with checkbox column for selecting individual rows and all rows, displaying user data with status badges and currency-formatted balance. Includes footer row showing total balance.
use_when: Displaying selectable data records where users need to select multiple rows and see aggregate totals.
avoid_when: Static data only — data fetches from hardcoded URL, not configurable for other datasets.
a11y: Checkboxes have aria-labels for "Select row" and "Select all". Indeterminate state handles partial selection.

name: comp-479
title: Sortable Columns Table
blurb: Sortable table with draggable column resizers and keyboard controls.
description: Data table where columns are sortable with chevron indicators and resizable by dragging handles between headers. Supports keyboard navigation (Enter/Space for sorting) with aria-sort attributes.
use_when: Users need to customize table layout and sort multiple columns interactively.
avoid_when: Data is dynamic with backend sorting — sorting is client-side only.
a11y: Sort headers are keyboard-accessible with aria-sort attributes. Resize handles are touch-enabled with visual feedback.

name: comp-478
title: Filterable Table
blurb: Data table with text search, range filters, and sortable columns.
description: Keyword research table with multi-type filters: text search for keywords, select dropdown for intent tags, and min/max range inputs for volume/CPC/traffic. Columns are sortable with aria-sort attributes.
use_when: Large datasets that require users to filter by multiple column types and sort interactively.
avoid_when: When data is dynamic and needs real-time backend filtering — filtering is client-side only.
a11y: Column headers are keyboard-accessible for sorting (Enter/Space). Range inputs have aria-labels. Intent tags use hardcoded foreground colors with good contrast.

name: comp-480
title: Pinnable Columns Table
blurb: Table with columns pinnable to left or right edges.
description: Data table where columns can be pinned to the left or right side via dropdown menu controls. Pinned columns remain visible during horizontal scroll with sticky positioning and subtle backdrop blur separation.
use_when: Wide tables where users need to keep certain columns (like ID or name) visible while scrolling horizontally.
avoid_when: On narrow viewports — pinning reduces horizontal space quickly.
a11y: Pin controls have aria-labels describing the column name. Keyboard accessible through dropdown menus.

name: comp-476
title: Feature Compatibility Table
blurb: Browser compatibility matrix with rotated headers and support indicators.
description: Displays CSS feature support across desktop and mobile browsers with version numbers. Each cell shows a checkmark or X with browser version in a compact, scannable grid with sideways-oriented headers.
use_when: Documenting feature support across browsers, building reference tables for CSS capabilities.
avoid_when: When data is dynamic or needs frequent updates — data is hardcoded in the component.
a11y: Icon indicators are aria-hidden with sr-only text fallbacks for "Supported" and "Not supported". Column headers include sr-only text identifying Desktop/Mobile groups.

name: comp-481
title: Draggable Columns Table
blurb: Table columns reorderable by dragging, with grip handles and sort controls.
description: Data table where column headers have drag handles to reorder columns horizontally. Each column can also be sorted via chevron button. Uses dnd-kit with horizontal-axis restriction and supports mouse, touch, and keyboard input.
use_when: Users need flexible column arrangement combined with sorting capability.
avoid_when: On touch-only devices — dragging columns feels awkward compared to native gestures.
a11y: Drag handles have aria-label "Drag to reorder". Sort buttons are keyboard-accessible. Drag also works via keyboard.

name: comp-482
title: Expandable Rows Table
blurb: Table rows that expand to reveal additional details below.
description: Data table with expandable rows showing additional note content. First column has chevron toggle button. Only rows with notes are expandable. Includes row selection checkboxes.
use_when: Tables where users need to see optional details per row without navigating to a detail page.
avoid_when: When most rows have expandable content — the expand pattern becomes tedious, use a detail view instead.
a11y: Expand buttons have aria-expanded attribute. aria-labels describe what will expand/collapse. Sub-row content is a full-width cell.

name: comp-483
title: Paginated Sortable Table
blurb: Paginated table with sortable columns and per-page size control.
description: Data table with pagination controls (first/previous/next/last buttons), adjustable rows per page (5/10/25/50), page info display, and sortable columns with chevrow indicators. Uses aria-live for page info updates.
use_when: Large datasets that need pagination for performance and sortable columns for organization.
avoid_when: Small datasets under 50 rows — pagination overhead hurts usability.
a11y: Pagination buttons have aria-labels. Page info uses aria-live="polite" for screen reader announcements. Sort headers support keyboard access.

name: comp-484
title: Table With Ellipsis Pagination
blurb: Paginated table with numbered page buttons and ellipsis between page ranges.
description: Data table with smart pagination showing numbered page buttons (5 at a time), ellipsis for skipped ranges, previous/next buttons, and rows-per-page selector. Includes aria-live updates and aria-current on active page.
use_when: Tables with many pages where users want to jump to specific page numbers, not just next/previous.
avoid_when: Very large datasets (1000+ pages) — even with ellipsis, pagination buttons overwhelm the UI.
a11y: Page buttons have aria-current="page" when active. Previous/next buttons have aria-labels. Page info uses aria-live="polite".

name: comp-485
title: Filterable Data Table
blurb: Enterprise data table with search, status filters, bulk actions, and column…
description: Full-featured data table with multi-column search (name/email), status filter popover with counts, column visibility toggle, sortable columns, pagination controls, row selection, bulk delete with confirmation, row action menu, and add user…
use_when: Admin panels or dashboards where users need comprehensive table control: search, filter, view customization, bulk…
avoid_when: Simple read-only data display — too many features add unnecessary complexity.
a11y: All buttons have aria-labels. Filters use proper labels. Delete uses AlertDialog for confirmation. Column visibility toggles use checkboxes. Keyboard accessible throughout.

name: comp-486
title: Numeric Range Input
blurb: Two number inputs for min and max values in a range.
description: A pair of number inputs (From and To) with spin buttons removed via CSS. Inputs are adjacent with focus z-index management.
use_when: Price filters, age ranges, or any min-max numeric input in forms.
avoid_when: You need a slider or drag-based range input.
a11y: Both inputs have aria-labels. Focus management via z-index. No placeholder-only labels.

name: comp-490
title: Single Date Calendar
blurb: Single date picker with month navigation.
description: A calendar for selecting a single date from a month grid with previous/next navigation.
use_when: You need a simple date picker for forms.
avoid_when: When you need date ranges or multiple date selection.
a11y: Calendar grid with standard button controls. Keyboard navigation depends on implementation.

name: comp-492
title: Disabled Dates Calendar
blurb: Calendar with disabled dates shown grayed.
description: A calendar showing certain dates as disabled/unavailable with reduced opacity and no click handler.
use_when: You need to prevent selection of specific dates (booked, past, holidays).
avoid_when: When all dates are available.
a11y: Disabled dates have aria-disabled attribute. Visually distinguished by opacity.

name: comp-493
title: Multiple Day Calendar
blurb: Calendar allowing multiple dates to be selected.
description: A calendar where multiple non-contiguous dates can be selected and marked.
use_when: You need users to pick multiple specific dates (recurring events, batch dates).
avoid_when: For single-date or range selection.
a11y: Selected dates highlighted. Multiple selection state trackable.

name: comp-494
title: Rounded Day Calendar
blurb: Calendar with rounded day buttons.
description: A calendar styled with fully rounded day buttons for a softer appearance.
use_when: You want a calendar that matches a rounded design system.
avoid_when: When sharp, minimal corners are the design target.
a11y: Standard calendar accessibility. Visual rounding is CSS only.

name: comp-491
title: Date Range Calendar
blurb: Date range picker with start/end selection.
description: A calendar for selecting a date range by clicking a start date then an end date.
use_when: You need users to pick date ranges (checkin/checkout, report periods).
avoid_when: For single date selection; use a simpler picker.
a11y: Calendar grid with range indicators. Selection state shown visually.

name: comp-496
title: Right Navigation Calendar
blurb: Calendar with right-aligned navigation buttons.
description: A calendar layout with previous/next navigation buttons positioned on the right side.
use_when: You need a right-to-left or custom-layout calendar.
avoid_when: When standard left-right navigation matches your design.
a11y: Navigation buttons have standard semantics. Layout is visual only.

name: comp-495
title: Custom Range Style Calendar
blurb: Date range with custom styling on range span.
description: A date range calendar with custom background/text colors applied to the selected range.
use_when: You want a visually distinct range with custom brand colors.
avoid_when: When default range styling is sufficient.
a11y: Range indicated with background color. Keyboard navigation available.

name: comp-498
title: Year Select Calendar
blurb: Year picker for selecting years only.
description: A calendar simplified to year selection only, showing a grid of years with navigation.
use_when: You need users to pick years (birthdate, historical ranges).
avoid_when: When specific dates are needed.
a11y: Year grid with keyboard navigation. Selected year highlighted.

name: comp-497
title: Month Year Dropdown Calendar
blurb: Dropdowns select month and year instead of arrows.
description: A calendar with month/year selection via dropdown menus instead of prev/next navigation arrows.
use_when: You need fast year/month navigation (especially for historical dates).
avoid_when: When quick month-by-month browsing is the main use case.
a11y: Dropdowns with aria-label. Selection changes trigger calendar update.

name: comp-500
title: Calendar With Month Button
blurb: Button to jump to selected month.
description: A calendar with an extra button that jumps to the currently selected or current month.
use_when: You want users to quickly navigate back to the current/selected month.
avoid_when: When month navigation is simple enough without an extra button.
a11y: Month button has aria-label. Clicking returns to reference month.

name: comp-499
title: Week Numbers Calendar
blurb: Calendar grid includes ISO week numbers.
description: A calendar showing ISO week numbers in the leftmost column for reference.
use_when: You need to reference or select by week number (business/project planning).
avoid_when: When week numbers are not relevant to the user.
a11y: Week numbers shown but not interactive. Date selection still primary.

name: comp-501
title: Calendar With Today Button
blurb: Button to jump to today's date.
description: A calendar with a 'Today' button that selects and displays the current date.
use_when: You want quick access to today for date pickers.
avoid_when: When today is not a relevant reference point.
a11y: Today button has aria-label. Clicking selects current date.

name: comp-502
title: Calendar With Date Input
blurb: Text input field synced with calendar selection.
description: A calendar paired with a text input field where selected dates appear, supporting both visual and typed date entry.
use_when: Users can both click and type dates.
avoid_when: When clicking only is sufficient.
a11y: Input field has aria-label. Calendar and input stay synchronized.

name: comp-504
title: Advanced Year Month Picker
blurb: Year and month picker in one advanced UI.
description: An advanced calendar interface allowing simultaneous year and month selection with a grid-based picker.
use_when: You need fast, intuitive year-month navigation without clicking many times.
avoid_when: When simple prev/next navigation is preferred.
a11y: Year/month grid with keyboard navigation. Selection state clear.

name: comp-503
title: Calendar With Time Input
blurb: Calendar with time picker (hour/minute).
description: A calendar with integrated time input (hours and minutes) for selecting a specific date and time.
use_when: You need users to pick both date and time.
avoid_when: When only dates are needed.
a11y: Time inputs accessible as separate controls. Calendar and time synced.

name: comp-505
title: Calendar Time Slot Picker
blurb: Calendar and time slot selector side-by-side in a responsive layout.
description: A date picker paired with a scrollable time slot list. Selecting a date updates the time slots shown. Disabled slots are unclickable.
use_when: Users need to book an appointment by picking both date and time.
avoid_when: Small touch screens — the two-column layout becomes cramped on mobile.
a11y: Uses aria-live to announce selections. Calendar handles focus and keyboard navigation. Button states communicate availability.

name: comp-506
title: Calendar With Presets
blurb: Calendar with quick-preset buttons for common date ranges.
description: A calendar with preset shortcuts on the left (Today, Yesterday, Last week, Last month, Last year). Clicking a preset sets both the calendar view and selected date. Only past dates are selectable.
use_when: Users often need to pick dates from recent history and appreciate quick shortcuts.
avoid_when: When future dates are needed — the component disables all future selections.
a11y: Uses aria-live for announcements. Buttons and calendar navigation are keyboard-accessible.

name: comp-507
title: Date Range Preset Picker
blurb: Date range picker with preset shortcuts for common ranges.
description: Selects a start and end date using a calendar in range mode. Preset buttons set common ranges (Today, Last 7 days, Month to date, etc). Only past dates are available.
use_when: Filtering data by date range where users benefit from quick presets like 'Last 30 days' or 'Year to date'.
avoid_when: When only single dates are needed, or when future dates must be selectable.
a11y: Keyboard navigation through calendar and presets. aria-live announces range selections.

name: comp-508
title: Two Month Range Calendar
blurb: Two-month calendar view for selecting date ranges at a glance.
description: Displays two consecutive months side-by-side in range mode. Uses paged navigation (forward/back arrows) to move through months. Separator line divides the two calendars.
use_when: Users need to span a range across two months and appreciate seeing both months simultaneously.
avoid_when: Very small screens where two months don't fit without horizontal scroll.
a11y: Calendar navigation is keyboard-accessible. aria-live announces date selections.

name: comp-509
title: Three Month Range Calendar
blurb: Three-month calendar view for spanning longer date ranges.
description: Displays three consecutive months in range mode, laid out responsively (stacked on mobile, side-by-side on desktop). Paged navigation moves through months. Separator lines divide the calendars.
use_when: Users need to select spans across three months, such as quarterly date ranges.
avoid_when: Mobile devices with limited screen width — three months may stack awkwardly.
a11y: Keyboard-accessible calendar navigation. aria-live for date selection announcements.

name: comp-512
title: Date Range Popover Picker
blurb: Button that opens a calendar popover for selecting a date range.
description: A labeled form control showing the selected date range or placeholder. Button displays 'Start - End' format. Popover contains a calendar in range mode for selecting both dates.
use_when: You need a compact date range picker that hides the calendar until clicked.
avoid_when: When users need to see two full months simultaneously to span across months.
a11y: Label properly associated. Keyboard-accessible popover and calendar. aria-live for selections.

name: comp-510
title: Pricing Calendar
blurb: Calendar showing prices under each date with color-coded bargain indicators.
description: Two-month calendar overlaying prices on each day. Good prices (under $100) are highlighted in emerald green. Custom DayButton component renders date + price. Dates without pricing data are disabled.
use_when: Flight or hotel bookings where users need to see pricing across dates and identify bargains at a glance.
avoid_when: When prices exceed a few characters — they'll overflow the small button space.
a11y: Calendar is keyboard-accessible. Prices are inline text, readable by screen readers.

name: comp-511
title: Single Date Popover Picker
blurb: Button that opens a calendar in a popover to select a single date.
description: A labeled form control with a button trigger showing the selected date or placeholder. Clicking opens a popover with a calendar. Uses Radix Popover and React DayPicker.
use_when: You need a compact date picker that saves space by hiding the calendar until clicked.
avoid_when: When users need to see multiple months at once — popovers typically show one month.
a11y: Label is properly associated with the button. Popover is keyboard-accessible. aria-live announces selections.

name: comp-544
title: Image Cover Dropzone
blurb: Large dropzone with image preview filling the background.
description: Drag-and-drop upload area that displays selected image as full background when loaded. Shows upload instructions when empty; 5MB size limit.
use_when: Cover images, hero images, or full-width image selections.
avoid_when: Multiple file uploads; this is single-image only.
a11y: Drop area is keyboard accessible with tabindex -1. Input sr-only. Remove button clearly labeled.

name: comp-546
title: Multi Image Upload Grid
blurb: Grid layout for uploading and previewing multiple images.
description: Multi-image uploader with drag-and-drop support, displaying thumbnails in a grid layout. Each image can be individually removed.
use_when: Bulk photo uploads, gallery management, product image sets.
avoid_when: Single image uploads; use single-file variants instead.
a11y: Drop area keyboard accessible. Each image item has remove button with clear label.

name: comp-545
title: Image Preview Dropzone
blurb: Dropzone with centered image preview, aspect-ratio preserved.
description: Drag-and-drop upload for single image with centered, contain-fit display. Shows instructions when empty; supports SVG, PNG, JPEG, GIF.
use_when: Icon uploads, logo uploads, or cases where image aspect ratio must be preserved.
avoid_when: Full-bleed cover images; use comp-544 for that.
a11y: Drop area is keyboard accessible. Input sr-only. Clear upload instructions provided.

name: comp-549
title: Multi File Upload List
blurb: Vertical list upload for multiple files with details and progress.
description: Multi-file uploader in list format showing file names, sizes, and upload progress. Each file has individual remove control.
use_when: Bulk document uploads, file management interfaces, or detailed progress tracking.
avoid_when: Quick image galleries; use grid layout instead.
a11y: List items are accessible. Progress announcements via live region.

name: comp-548
title: Single File Dropzone
blurb: Single file dropzone with validation and progress feedback.
description: Drag-and-drop area for one file with size/type validation, error display, and upload state feedback.
use_when: Single document or file uploads with validation feedback.
avoid_when: Multiple files; use multi-file variants instead.
a11y: Drop area keyboard accessible. Error messages announced via live region.

name: comp-547
title: Image Upload List
blurb: Vertical list of uploaded images with file info and remove buttons.
description: Multi-image upload in list format, showing thumbnails, file names, and size. Each item has individual remove control.
use_when: Document uploads, file browser style interfaces, or detail-focused image lists.
avoid_when: High-volume uploads where grid layout is more compact.
a11y: Each list item is accessible. Remove buttons clearly labeled with file names.

name: comp-551
title: File Upload Table View
blurb: File uploads displayed in a data table with sortable columns.
description: Multi-file upload manager using table layout. Shows file name, size, upload date, status with sortable columns and bulk actions.
use_when: Enterprise file management, data-heavy upload flows, or large file collections.
avoid_when: Mobile or responsive contexts; tables don't scale well.
a11y: Table follows ARIA table semantics. Sortable headers have buttons with aria-sort.

name: comp-550
title: File Type Upload List
blurb: File list with type icons and validation for mixed file types.
description: Multi-file upload showing icons based on file type (pdf, image, doc, etc). Supports mixed file types with individual removal.
use_when: Document collections, mixed media uploads, or visually distinct file type handling.
avoid_when: Single file type uploads; use specialized variants instead.
a11y: File type icons have implicit role via list structure. Remove buttons clearly labeled.

name: comp-553
title: Mixed File Upload Manager
blurb: Mixed file and image uploads in a unified grid interface.
description: Multi-file uploader displaying both images as thumbnails and other files as type icons in a single grid. All removable.
use_when: Media + document uploads, unified file management, flexible asset collections.
avoid_when: File-type-specific flows; use specialized variants for single-type focus.
a11y: Grid structure with accessible file type indicators and remove buttons.

name: comp-552
title: File Upload Icon Grid
blurb: Grid of file type icons with file names and sizes.
description: Multi-file upload in icon grid layout. Each file shown as icon representation by type with name and size, removable.
use_when: File management dashboards, compact file browsers, visual file collections.
avoid_when: Image-heavy uploads; use image-specific variants instead.
a11y: Icons have implicit labels via associated file names. Grid is keyboard navigable.

name: comp-543
title: Avatar Image Uploader
blurb: Avatar uploader with drag-and-drop support and dragging visual feedback.
description: Circular avatar upload button that accepts click or drag-drop. Shows hover/dragging state and displays preview when image is loaded.
use_when: Profile or team member avatars with intuitive drag-and-drop.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices where drag-and-drop gestures are unclear.
a11y: Button has aria-label. Drop area responds to drag events. Input sr-only.

name: comp-578
title: Mega Menu Navbar
blurb: Mega menu navbar with icon, description, and simple submenu types.
description: Responsive header with desktop mega menu (descriptions/icons/simple items) and mobile popover. Collapses cleanly at breakpoint.
use_when: You need multi-level navigation with mixed content types (descriptions, icons, simple links) in a compact header.
avoid_when: Simple linear navigation; mega menus add complexity and desk space.
a11y: Keyboard-navigable nav menu. Mobile menu managed with aria-expanded. Links are semantic.

name: comp-579
title: Simple Responsive Navbar
blurb: Simple responsive navbar with underline active state.
description: Minimal header with logo, text nav links, and auth buttons. Active link underlined on desktop; mobile menu hidden behind popover.
use_when: You need a clean, fast-loading header without mega menus or search.
avoid_when: Complex multi-level navigation or heavy icon-based site structure.
a11y: Keyboard-navigable menu. Mobile menu managed with aria-expanded. Links are semantic.

name: comp-582
title: Icon Nav With Language Select
blurb: Icon-only navbar with language selector and theme toggle.
description: Header with icon nav links, language select dropdown, and theme toggle. Icons shown with tooltips on desktop; text labels on mobile.
use_when: Global apps needing language/theme controls at the top with a compact icon-based nav.
avoid_when: Users unfamiliar with icon-only interfaces.
a11y: Icons have aria-label. Tooltips on hover (desktop). Theme toggle is keyboard-accessible. Language selector has aria-label.

name: comp-580
title: Ecommerce Search Navbar
blurb: E-commerce navbar with search, mobile cart badge, category links.
description: Header with logo, search input (desktop + mobile), category nav, cart/sign-in buttons. Mobile menu hides nav, includes cart counter.
use_when: E-commerce or retail app with product search and quick cart access in the header.
avoid_when: Content-heavy sites; search placement competes with other navigation.
a11y: Search input labeled. Mobile menu managed with aria-expanded. Cart badge counts with semantic markup.

name: comp-581
title: Minimal Auth Navbar
blurb: Minimal navbar with logo, nav links, info/notification/user menus.
description: Clean header with logo, simple nav links, and icon-based menus (info, notifications, user). Responsive mobile menu.
use_when: SaaS or apps needing a polished, uncluttered header with user account features.
avoid_when: Heavy content navigation or mega menus.
a11y: Keyboard-navigable menu. Mobile menu managed with aria-expanded. Icon buttons labeled.

name: comp-583
title: Breadcrumb Project Header
blurb: Breadcrumb header with dropdown project selector.
description: Header showing breadcrumb navigation with account/project hierarchy. Project selector is a dropdown menu. Notification and user menus included.
use_when: Multi-tenant or project-based apps showing user location in hierarchy with quick project switching.
avoid_when: Linear navigation; breadcrumbs are better for deep hierarchies.
a11y: Breadcrumb items are navigable. Project selector has aria-label. Mobile menu collapses at breakpoint.

name: comp-584
title: Simple Nav Header
blurb: Navbar with search bar and bottom nav menu strip.
description: Header with logo, search input, notifications, and user menu. Below-header strip with text nav links. Responsive: mobile hides nav strip.
use_when: Apps with central search as a key feature, plus secondary navigation underneath the header.
avoid_when: Limited vertical space; this layout takes two rows at minimum on desktop.
a11y: Search input labeled. Nav links keyboard-navigable. Mobile search icon visible; desktop shows full search input.

name: comp-585
title: Icon Nav Team Header
blurb: Icon navbar with search, team icons, notifications, user menu.
description: Header with icon nav buttons, search input, icon navigation menu, message/notification buttons, and user menu.
use_when: Collaboration apps or team tools needing quick access to search, messaging, and team features.
avoid_when: Text-first navigation; icon-only nav requires user familiarity.
a11y: Icons have aria-label or sr-only text. Search input labeled. Nav menu keyboard-navigable.

name: comp-587
title: App Icon Nav Header
blurb: Icon navbar with app shortcuts, notifications, and upgrade button.
description: Header with icon navigation menu, app switcher menu (multiple apps), notifications, user dropdown, and highlighted upgrade button.
use_when: Product suites or multi-app platforms where users need quick app switching.
avoid_when: Single-app experiences; app switcher adds visual weight.
a11y: Icons have aria-label or sr-only. App menu managed with aria-expanded. Upgrade button is semantic.

name: comp-586
title: Search Bar Header
blurb: Centered search navbar with voice input and auth buttons.
description: Header with logo on left, centered search bar with voice button, community link and sign-in/start buttons on right. Theme toggle included.
use_when: Search-first interfaces (apps, content discovery) with optional voice input.
avoid_when: Content-heavy navigation or tight horizontal space.
a11y: Search input labeled. Voice button has aria-label. Auth links are semantic. Theme toggle keyboard-accessible.

name: comp-588
title: Icon Nav Avatar Header

description: Renders an animated shine/gloss effect that sweeps across child content. Runs continuously, on hover, or on click with customizable color, opacity, and direction.
use_when: Buttons, cards, or premium UI elements where a shine effect adds perceived polish and draws visual attention.
avoid_when: Content already using shine effects where layering might create visual noise.
a11y: Shine effect is purely visual; no impact on semantic content or keyboard interaction.

name: primitives-effects-theme-toggler
title: Theme Toggler
blurb: Theme switcher with View Transition API animations and direction options.
description: Primitive component for theme management with optional View Transition API animations. Accepts theme state and direction prop to customize clip animation path.
use_when: Building theme switchers that need smooth transitions between light/dark/system modes with directional animations.
avoid_when: When View Transition API is not supported or when browser compatibility is a concern.
a11y: Render function receives theme state and toggleTheme callback. Accessibility depends on how the render function is implemented.

name: primitives-headless-checkbox
title: Headless Checkbox
blurb: Animated checkbox with Headless UI and Framer Motion with indeterminate support.
description: Checkbox primitive using Headless UI with Framer Motion animations. Supports checked and indeterminate states with path animations. Renders render function children.
use_when: Building custom checkbox designs with smooth animations and multi-state support.
avoid_when: When you need simple unstyled checkboxes without animation overhead.
a11y: Built on Headless UI checkbox primitive which provides full keyboard and screen reader support.

blurb: Dialog flips in from a direction with 3D perspective and blur.
description: Headless UI dialog wrapped with Framer Motion that animates panel entrance with 3D perspective rotation. Direction configurable (top/bottom/left/right). Backdrop fades with blur. Composed header, title, description, and footer.
use_when: You want a polished modal with directional entrance animations that feel dimensional.
avoid_when: Older browsers or performance-sensitive contexts — 3D perspective has render costs.
a11y: Built on Headless UI primitives with full keyboard support (Escape closes). Render prop pattern on DialogPanel for advanced composition.

name: primitives-headless-disclosure
title: Headless Disclosure
blurb: Headless disclosure component for custom styling.
description: Animate UI's disclosure primitive: unstyled button + panel wrapper for complete custom control.
use_when: Building fully custom disclosure interactions without predefined styling.
avoid_when: When you want pre-styled components.
a11y: Headless primitives require manual aria handling.

name: primitives-headless-popover
title: Headless Popover
blurb: Floating panel scales in from center with spring animation.
description: Headless UI popover with Framer Motion animations. Panel scales and fades in/out with spring physics. Supports backdrop, button, and group composition for managing multiple popovers.
use_when: You need a lightweight, accessible popover with smooth scale animation.
avoid_when: Fixed positioning is needed — this uses absolute positioning anchored to parent.
a11y: Full Headless UI popover accessibility: keyboard navigation, focus management, Escape closes.

name: primitives-headless-tabs
title: Headless Switch
blurb: Animated tab switcher with composable thumb and icon components.
description: Tab switcher primitive using Headless UI with Framer Motion. Features composable SwitchThumb and SwitchIcon components for tab animation.
use_when: Building animated tab interfaces with smooth transitions between content sections.
avoid_when: When you need a simple tab switcher without animation or custom composition.
a11y: Built on Headless UI primitives with full keyboard navigation and screen reader support.

name: primitives-headless-switch
title: Headless Switch
blurb: Animated toggle switch with composable thumb and icon components.
description: Switch primitive using Headless UI with Framer Motion. Features composable SwitchThumb and SwitchIcon components with spring animations.
use_when: Building premium animated switches with custom icon positioning and fine-tuned motion control.
avoid_when: When you need a simple switch without animation or custom composition.
a11y: Built on Headless UI switch primitive with full keyboard and screen reader support.

name: primitives-radix-progress
title: Radix Progress
blurb: Animated progress bar using Radix UI with spring motion fills.
description: A progress bar component wrapping Radix UI's Progress primitive with Framer Motion-animated indicator fill that uses spring physics for smooth transitions.
use_when: Building accessible progress bars with polished animated fills.
avoid_when: When static progress bars are sufficient.
a11y: Built on Radix UI primitives with full accessibility support.

name: primitives-texts-gradient
title: Gradient Text
blurb: Text fills with an animated gradient.
description: Applies a multi-stop gradient to text with animation that shifts color positions over time, creating a flowing color effect.
use_when: Eye-catching headlines or premium branding elements.
avoid_when: Low-contrast environments or accessibility-critical labels — gradients reduce readability.
a11y: Text is readable but gradient may reduce contrast. Animation runs uncontrolled.

name: primitives-texts-highlight
title: Highlight Text
blurb: Text glows with a highlight that pulses behind it.
description: Renders text with a backdrop glow or highlight that animates in and out, emphasizing key words.
use_when: Accent words or phrases within body copy that deserve visual pop.
avoid_when: Full headings — a highlight every few words becomes chaotic.
a11y: Text is readable. Animation is decorative with no interaction barrier.

name: primitives-texts-rolling
title: Rolling Text
blurb: Text characters roll vertically like a flip clock.
description: Each character animates upward through the alphabet or digit set before settling on the target character.
use_when: Score displays, counters, or time-based elements.
avoid_when: Reading new text — the roll-up animation masks content during transition.
a11y: Text is readable after animation settles but hidden during the roll.

name: primitives-texts-counting-number
title: Counting Number
blurb: Number increments smoothly from zero to a target.
description: Animates a numeric display by incrementing the value over a duration, often triggered by scroll into view.
use_when: Statistics, metrics, or KPIs in hero sections or feature cards.
avoid_when: Precise or real-time values — animation introduces rounding and lag.
a11y: End value is readable but animation runs automatically with no pause control.

name: primitives-texts-shimmering
title: Shimmering Text
blurb: Text glimmers with a moving light reflection.
description: Applies a shimmer or highlight effect that moves across text like a light source sweeping side-to-side.
use_when: Skeleton loaders or premium text elements.
avoid_when: Body text — shimmer is distracting to read.
a11y: Text is readable but animation runs continuously. No motion preference support.

name: primitives-texts-rotating
title: Rotating Text
blurb: Text cycles through a list, rotating on a timer.
description: Displays words or phrases from an array, swapping to the next after a delay with optional entrance/exit animations.
use_when: Feature lists or rotating testimonials.
avoid_when: Static content — rotating just adds distraction.
a11y: Only one item visible at a time. Screen readers see the current word but may miss others.

name: primitives-texts-splitting
title: Splitting Text
blurb: Text splits and spreads apart with animation.
description: Characters or words separate and move apart, then recombine, often on scroll or hover.
use_when: Dramatic entrance or hover effects on headlines.
avoid_when: Body copy — splitting destroys readability.
a11y: Text may be unreachable or unreadable during animation.

name: primitives-texts-sliding-number
title: Sliding Number
blurb: Number slides up or down to its target value.
description: Animates a numeric value by sliding it vertically from current to target position, often triggered by scroll or on mount.
use_when: Stat counters or progress displays.
avoid_when: Frequently changing values — repeated slides can feel janky.
a11y: Target number is readable after slide completes.

name: primitives-texts-scrolling-number
title: Scrolling Number
blurb: Numbers scroll vertically like a carousel of digits.
description: Renders a set of digit containers that scroll through available numbers, useful for displaying stats or odometers.
use_when: Metrics dashboards or live-updating counters.
avoid_when: High-frequency updates — rapid scrolling becomes a blur.
a11y: Only the visible digit is readable at any moment.

name: primitives-texts-typing
title: Typing Text
blurb: Text appears character-by-character as if being typed.
description: Animates text as a typewriter effect, revealing characters sequentially with optional cursor animation.
use_when: Narratives, code snippets, or onboarding text.
avoid_when: Body content — typing delay makes the text unavailable until animation completes.
a11y: Content is hidden until typed. Screen readers may announce before visible.

name: primitives-texts-morphing
title: Morphing Text
blurb: Text smoothly animates between words in a cycling list.
description: Morphs between a series of words with a canvas or SVG-based animation that blends letter shapes.
use_when: Dynamic taglines or feature descriptions cycling through related terms.
avoid_when: Large word lists — morphing becomes choppy and hard to read.
a11y: Only the current morph frame is readable. No pause or pause control.

name: proxy-admin
title: Proxy Admin
blurb: Dashboard for managing LLM provider credentials and model configuration.
description: A control panel that connects to a proxykit API to display provider status, manage OAuth authentication, refresh tokens, and test LLM models with custom parameters.
use_when: Building an admin interface for LLM gateway configuration, provider auth management, or model testing.
avoid_when: When you don't need API integration or auth flows — this component depends on a live proxykit backend.
a11y: Semantic HTML with buttons, forms, and lists. Uses toast notifications for user feedback.
